Study notes · 21_torus12_code_a72index
462.8 ms (jones) / 336.0 ms (transport) · 4.5 ions per transport instruction · not buildable · up to 2 waveforms a cycle, no select bits, shims 0.2 ms at 1:1 / 3.8 ms at 1:16 · R10: Lean checker + tableau
the code's cell (i, j) laid at columns i, rows 2j and 2j+1 via --init-placement: 462.8 ms at 4.54 ions per instruction, 1.12x the compiler's own placement (20, 516.4 ms). It runs under the one-waveform model (control.model simd_classes: one motion a cycle, the R22 split) on direct wiring, so its time is an upper bound for a direct machine. Before the R22 split the two placements tied (the study's 99 and 97 ms).
